name: inclusionai/ming-3.0-audio-flash
title: Ming-3.0-audio-flash leads speech reasoning and is open weights
summary: Ant Ling released Ming-3.0-audio-flash under the MIT license for audio reasoning. It ranks first on Artificial Analysis Speech Reasoning, Big Bench Audio, at 99.8 percent accuracy, ahead of Grok Voice 3.0, Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking (High), and GPT-Realtime-2.1 High.
